engagement.model: Rodent rheumatoid-arthritis models with ex-vivo LPS whole-blood cytokine PD (ARRY-797)
engagement.note: Opening entry: ARRY-797 was characterised in rodent RA models and an ex-vivo cytokine assay before any human PD readout.
engagement.short: ARRY-797 rodent RA model, no human PD yet
engagement.quote: ARRY-797, a selective, potent inhibitor of p38 active in animal models of rheumatoid arthritis, inhibits ex vivo IL-1, PGE2 and TNF production in normal human subjects
engagement.confidence_note: Sponsor conference abstract (Inflamm Res 2007;56 Suppl 3:S376-S377, abstract-book DOI, PMC7095932); only the title was retrievable, the body is not online. Dated June 2007 (ResearchGate record).
engagement.judgement: Opens the track at its first public use (2007). The model is an RA model used for an OA context, so model_kind is cross_indication rather than animal; it was the only disease model ARRY-797 went into OA patients on.

engagement.model: Rodent rheumatoid-arthritis models with ex-vivo LPS whole-blood cytokine PD (ARRY-797)
engagement.note: ARRY-797, active in rodent RA models, blocked ex-vivo IL-1, PGE2 and TNF production in blood from dosed healthy subjects; Mavers 2009 relays up to 100% inhibition.
engagement.short: Ex-vivo cytokine blockade seen in dosed volunteers
engagement.quote: ARRY-797, a selective, potent inhibitor of p38 active in animal models of rheumatoid arthritis, inhibits ex vivo IL-1, PGE2 and TNF production in normal human subjects
engagement.confidence_note: Title-only reading: the abstract body could not be retrieved (PMC and Springer PDFs blocked; ResearchGate metadata only). The 'up to 100% inhibition' figure comes from the Mavers 2009 review (doi 10.1007/s11926-009-0054-9), which is a pointer, not a source. Healthy volunteers, not OA patients. Conference-abstract tier is the checker's open rule question; scored tier 1 on the DOI/PMC record.
engagement.judgement: Scored same because the source itself puts rodent-model activity and the human ex-vivo result side by side (comparison_stated true). Readout tier direct: ex-vivo blockade of an LPS stimulus in dosed subjects. Magnitude direction_only because the title gives no number. Two years before Hope 2009, so this is the class's first member-drug engagement comparison.
engagement.magnitude_basis: ex-vivo IL-1/PGE2/TNF inhibition in dosed healthy subjects (title reports direction only)

efficacy.model: Rodent rheumatoid-arthritis models with ex-vivo LPS whole-blood cytokine PD (ARRY-797)
efficacy.note: ARRY-797 was active in rodent RA models (Koch 2007); PH-797804 likewise cut joint inflammation and bone loss in rat SCW arthritis and mouse CIA (Hope 2009). No OA patient result yet.
efficacy.short: Member drugs active in rodent RA models
efficacy.quote: ARRY-797, a selective, potent inhibitor of p38 active in animal models of rheumatoid arthritis, inhibits ex vivo IL-1, PGE2 and TNF production in normal human subjects
efficacy.confidence_note: Title-only reading of a sponsor conference abstract; which rodent RA models and what endpoints are not retrievable. Hope 2009 (doi 10.1124/jpet.109.158329, abstract) names rat streptococcal-cell-wall arthritis and mouse collagen-induced arthritis for PH-797804.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry: the system the lead member went into OA patients on was an RA model, not an OA model, so the efficacy prediction for OA pain is cross-indication. No OA patient datum existed in 2007.

efficacy.model: Rodent rheumatoid-arthritis models with ex-vivo LPS whole-blood cytokine PD (ARRY-797)
efficacy.note: ARRY-797 400 mg q12h beat placebo on the primary WOMAC pain endpoint at week 4 (-2.4 vs -1.6, one-sided p=0.0247) in 157 NSAID-refractory knee-OA patients.
efficacy.short: ARRY-797 met WOMAC pain primary endpoint
efficacy.quote: ARRY-797 provided statistically significantly greater improvement (-0.8) for the primary endpoint of WOMAC pain at Week 4 (-2.4 vs -1.6; 1-sided p = 0.0247).
efficacy.confidence_note: Sponsor-authored ACR 2012 late-breaking abstract (first public 2012-07-31 Array press release); no peer-reviewed paper and no registry results for NCT01366014 (first posted 2011-06-03, completed 2012-06). One-sided p=0.0247 is about two-sided 0.05. Model side is a title-only conference abstract.
efficacy.reason: ARRY-797 OA pain win after RA-model activity
efficacy.judgement: Paired comparison (comparison_stated false): model side Koch 2007 (ARRY-797 itself active in rodent RA models, product_in_model true), patient side the ARRY-797 Phase 2 primary endpoint in OA. Same in direction only: the model read joint inflammation in an RA model, the trial a 0-10 WOMAC pain NRS in OA, so magnitude is direction_only and the prediction is cross-indication. Source tier 5 with trial_unreported true, matching the draft's treatment of the same abstract. FX005 (NCT01291914) and PH-797804 (NCT01102660) were never run in this model, so they do not score here.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: WOMAC pain change vs placebo (0-10 NRS) against rodent RA-model activity; not commensurable

patient_trials.quote: Improvement in WOMAC pain for Oxy ER (-0.71) was comparable to that seen with ARRY-797 (-0.68) when LOCF was used for imputation of missing data.

engagement.short: Rat joint-degeneration readout, no human marker yet
engagement.quote: SB203580 and VX-745 demonstrated attenuation of both cartilage degeneration and pain in animal models and suggest that p38 inhibitors may be a useful approach for the treatment of osteoarthritis.
engagement.confidence_note: Open-access paper (PMID 19055838, epub 2008-12-04); no member drug was in this model. Entry added to the draft's existing track on the checker's lead, not a new system.
engagement.judgement: Opens the engagement cell on the existing rat-iodoacetate track at its first use (2008), so the strip shows the model existed four years before a patient cartilage/bone marker was compared.

engagement.model: Rat iodoacetate joint degeneration + carrageenan thermal hyperalgesia (SB-203580, VX-745)
engagement.note: ARRY-797 cut serum COMP 10% and CTX-I 38% vs placebo at week 4 in knee-OA patients; CTX-I fall was rapid, sustained, and reversed at follow-up.
engagement.short: Cartilage and bone markers fell in OA patients
engagement.quote: ARRY-797 treatment resulted in statistically significant decreases in COMP and CTX-I at Week 4 (10% and 38% vs PBO, respectively).
engagement.confidence_note: Sponsor-authored ACR 2012 late-breaking abstract (first public 2012-07-31 press release; PRNewswire 2012 release repeats the 10%/38% figures); no peer-reviewed paper, no registry results for NCT01366014. Serum COMP/CTX-I are systemic markers, not index-joint histology, and COMP's 10% change is small. Quote normalises the abstract's non-breaking hyphens.
engagement.reason: COMP and CTX-I fell as joint model predicted
engagement.judgement: Paired comparison (comparison_stated false): model side Brown 2008 (sibling inhibitors cut rat iodoacetate cartilage degeneration 31-45%), patient side circulating cartilage (COMP) and bone (CTX-I) degradation markers falling on ARRY-797. Readout tier downstream: a serum biomarker of the model's histological endpoint, not p38 occupancy. Magnitude direction_only because % histological inhibition and % serum-marker change are not commensurable. Tier 5 with trial_unreported true as for the same abstract elsewhere in the draft.
engagement.magnitude_basis: serum COMP (-10%) and CTX-I (-38%) vs placebo at week 4 against rat % joint-damage inhibition; not commensurable

considered_not_added: PH-797804 rat streptococcal-cell-wall arthritis and mouse collagen-induced arthritis (Hope 2009, doi 10.1124/jpet.109.158329): same rodent-RA system as the new track; PH-797804's own OA result (NCT01102660, completed 2011-02) was never reported, so it has no comparison of its own and is folded into the track's opening note rather than given a separate entry (a second untested entry would be a consecutive same-status entry).

PH-797804 human monocyte and synovial-fibroblast cytokine/PGE2 assays (Hope 2009): in-vitro potency that 'parallels' enzyme inhibition; the only human comparison is the endotoxin study the draft's rat-endotoxin-tnf-pd track already scores, so no separate system with a patient comparison.

PH-797804 nanocrystal microparticles in murine antigen-induced arthritis and mechanistic OA models (Maudens 2018, PMID 29524442, J Control Release): intra-articular formulation study published seven years after PH-797804's unreported OA trial; no patient comparison stated and no known OA result to retrodict, so neither retro nor contra.

FX005 preclinical efficacy model: the Flexion S-1 (2014-01-10) and the 2012 press release name no animal efficacy model for FX005, only the repeat-dose rat toxicology the draft's rat-ia-repeat-dose-tox track already carries; nothing to pair with the Phase 2a WOMAC result.

Patient-derived OA synoviocytes or chondrocytes exposed to p38 inhibitors (e.g. human OA synoviocyte MTT in Maudens 2018): no source compares any ex-vivo patient-cell result with clinical response for a member drug.

In-silico / QSP dose model: no PK/PD or QSP paper for any member beyond Hope 2009's rat-and-monkey exposure projection, which the draft's dose cell already scores; the 2019 UPLC-MS/MS paper (PMID 31785533) is a rat PK method only.

Human genetic model (MAPK14 loss-of-function carriers) and human challenge model in OA: none found for this class in OA; the endotoxin challenge in healthy volunteers is already the draft's engagement track.

Emprumapimod (ARRY-371797) Lmna H222P mouse cardiomyopathy model: another indication (LMNA dilated cardiomyopathy); no safety harm compared across indications, so nothing to import into the OA safety cell.
Regulator reliance: no member has an NDA/BLA (manifest rows 'no NDA/BLA'), so no FDA/EMA review relies on model data.
